description: Concise image generation prompt for Imagen 4.0. Optimized for prompt length limits while maintaining brand consistency.
base_system_prompt:
Professional product and lifestyle photography for Folly Nutrition, a premium women's hair health supplement brand.

STYLE RULES (follow exactly):
- High-key, flat, diffused lighting. No harsh shadows. Editorial beauty photography style.
- Background: pure white seamless or warm light gray. Nothing else.
- Color palette: pink, magenta, white, soft cream. NEVER purple, blue, neon, or orange.
- NO human faces. Show: hands, hair close-ups, loose gummies, ingredients, lifestyle flat-lays.
- When showing hair: natural texture, realistic, healthy-looking. No AI-smooth perfection.
- When showing product: ONLY show loose translucent pink/red gummy vitamins scattered artfully on a clean white surface. NEVER show bottles, packaging, labels, containers, boxes, or any branded packaging. Just the loose gummies by themselves.
- Mood: warm, scientific, premium, approachable. Not clinical, not sad, not overly cheerful.
- No text, no watermarks, no logos, no floating elements, no packaging.
- Must look like a real photo from a professional shoot, not AI-generated.
- CRITICAL: Do NOT generate any product packaging, bottles, boxes, or containers. Only loose gummy vitamins are allowed.
notes: Prompt kept concise for Imagen 4.0 token limits. No faces rule prevents the most common AI artifacts. Base prompt + template should stay under 500 words total.
